say:1:1120202001:1.text: Alsa, Soren, and <style="stress"><player_name></style>! It's great to see you all again!
say:1:1120202001:1.male: Alsa, Soren, and <style="stress"><player_name></style>! It's great to see you all again!
say:1:1120202001:1.female: Alsa, Soren, and <style="stress"><player_name></style>! It's great to see you all again!

say:2:1120202002:1.source_cn: 克鲁格，你怎么会来这里？

say:3:1120202003:2.text: I've come to tell you that Orson's funeral will be held in the coming days.
say:3:1120202003:2.source_cn: 我来是想要告诉各位，奥格的葬礼即将在近期举行。

say:4:1120202004:1.text: If you've got the time, I sincerely hope you can all come and see him off properly.
say:4:1120202004:1.source_cn: 如果诸位有时间的话，我真诚地希望你们能来参加葬礼，送他...

choice_prompt:5:1120202004.text: If you've got the time, I sincerely hope you can all come and see him off properly.
choice_prompt:5:1120202004.source_cn: 如果诸位有时间的话，我真诚地希望你们能来参加葬礼，送他最后一程。

say:6:1120202005:1.text: Because you witnessed Orson's passing, and you have close ties with the Grimmaw Clan.
say:6:1120202005:1.source_cn: 诸位见证了奥格的逝去，同时也与黑嚎氏族有千丝万缕的关系。

say:7:1120202007:1.text: Following the customs of the Grimmaw Clan, the funeral will be grand and dignified to show utmost respect to the departed warrior.
say:7:1120202007:1.source_cn: 按照黑嚎氏族的风俗，我们会以最隆重的方式举办，以此表达...

say:8:1120202008:1.text: Even though the "warrior" sold himself out to a Hypogean to get more power?
say:8:1120202008:1.source_cn: 即使这位“强者”为了获得力量，将自己出卖给了恶魔？

say:9:1120202009:1.text: I'm certain that was not Orson's intention. And... he's already paid the price for his actions.
say:9:1120202009:1.source_cn: 我相信那并非奥格的本意。而且……他也已经为自己的所作所...

say:10:1120202010:1.text: In any case, Orson is a hero to our Grimmaw Clan. We will honor him with a warrior's parting rite.
say:10:1120202010:1.source_cn: 无论如何，奥格都是我们黑嚎氏族的英雄。我们将以送别勇士...

say:11:1120202011:1.text: ... But what's that got to do with us?

say:12:1120202012:1.text: You won the Warsong Festival, Soren and Alsa.
say:12:1120202012:1.source_cn: 索恩，阿尔萨，你们是这次战歌节的胜者。

say:13:1120202013:1.text: In the public eye, we Grimmaw would like to maintain close ties with people as strong as you. And ideally, we'd turn you to our side.
say:13:1120202013:1.source_cn: 于公而言，黑嚎希望能和像你们这样的强者维持好关系，若是...

say:14:1120202014:1.text: More personally... You were there for Orson's final moments. As he suffered bitterly under Berial's manipulations, it was you who set him free and rescued him.
say:14:1120202014:1.source_cn: 于私而言……你们见证了奥格的终局。在他被恶魔操控而痛苦...

say:16:1120202016:1.text: ... Be that as it may, you did what I wasn't able to do. When he needed me most, I couldn't help him.
say:16:1120202016:1.source_cn: ……至少，你们做到了我没能做到的事情。那个时候，我帮不了他。

say:17:1120202017:1.text: Consider my invitation as a way of saying "thank you". And as an expression of Orson's gratitude.
say:17:1120202017:1.source_cn: 就当是我为了表达谢意才来邀请你们的如何？也为了帮奥格表...

say:19:1120202019:1.text: Fair enough. Take your time and think about it. Although... we also invited Brutus, and I'm sure he hopes to see you all again.
say:19:1120202019:1.source_cn: 没关系，你还有时间考虑。不过，我们还邀请了布鲁特斯大人...

say:20:1120202020:1.text: Well... I'm fine either way! What do you think, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:20:1120202020:1.male: Well... I'm fine either way! What do you think, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:20:1120202020:1.female: Well... I'm fine either way! What do you think, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?

choice_prompt:21:1120202020.text: Well... I'm fine either way! What do you think, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
choice_prompt:21:1120202020.source_cn: 这……我去不去都行啦，<style=stress><player_name></style>大人觉得呢？
choice_prompt:21:1120202020.male: Well... I'm fine either way! What do you think, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
choice_prompt:21:1120202020.female: Well... I'm fine either way! What do you think, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?

say:22:1120202021:2.text: I'm sorry, but I want nothing to do with the Grimmaw Clan anymore. After all... I can't trust you.
say:22:1120202021:2.source_cn: 抱歉，我已经不想和黑嚎再有任何瓜葛了。更何况……我也信...

say:23:1120202022:1.text: Indeed, you suffered much at our hands, and I apologize for that. But please believe me, those things happened for a reason and won't happen again.
say:23:1120202022:1.source_cn: 之前你在黑嚎营地确实经历了很多不愉快的事情，我对此深表...

say:24:1120202023:1.text: Soren, I didn't come to invite you because of your ties with the Grimmaw Clan... with Orson...
say:24:1120202023:1.source_cn: 索恩，我并不是因为你与黑嚎……与奥格的关系，才来邀请你...

say:25:1120202024:1.text: You're a warrior through and through, no matter what blood flows in your veins. In my eyes, you are just Soren, Soren of the Uru Clan.
say:25:1120202024:1.source_cn: 我将你视作一位纯粹的强者，与你身体里所流淌的血液无关，...

say:26:1120202025:1.text: You know very well that we Grimmaws admire strength. I know strength when I see it, and you have my respect.
say:26:1120202025:1.source_cn: 你知道的，黑嚎推崇力量。面对真正的强者，只会尊敬万分。

say:27:1120202026:1.text: He seems sincere to me... What do you think, Soren?
say:27:1120202026:1.source_cn: 他好像还挺真诚的……索恩，你觉得呢？

choice_prompt:28:1120202026.text: He seems sincere to me... What do you think, Soren?
choice_prompt:28:1120202026.source_cn: 他好像还挺真诚的……索恩，你觉得呢？

say:29:1120202027:2.text: ... Alright, I'll go to the funeral—but that's it.
say:29:1120202027:2.source_cn: ……好。我会参加葬礼。但是，也就仅此而已了。

say:30:1120202028:1.text: After the funeral, I'm done with the Grimmaw Clan. I don't want anything to do with you anymore.
say:30:1120202028:1.source_cn: 葬礼结束之后，我就会离开黑嚎氏族。并且……以后再也不和...

say:31:1120202029:1.text: Understood, with thanks. On behalf of the Grimmaw Clan, we eagerly await your arrival.
say:31:1120202029:1.source_cn: 我明白了。非常感谢你。届时，我会代表黑嚎氏族恭候各位的到来。

choice:5:0:1.text: Why'd you want to invite us?
choice:5:0:1.male: Why'd you want to invite us?
choice:5:0:1.female: Why'd you want to invite us?

say:33:1120202006:1.text: Yes, I came to the Uru Clan specifically to invite you all.
say:33:1120202006:1.source_cn: 没有找错人。我来乌尔聚落，就是专门邀请你们的。

say:0:1120203001:0.text: What are you doing up so early, Soren? Didn't you sleep last night?
say:0:1120203001:0.source_cn: 索恩，你竟然这么早就醒了……前一天晚上没有睡吗？

say:1:1120203002:0.text: ... I just want to be on time. I made a promise to attend, so I can't go back on my word.
say:1:1120203002:0.source_cn: ……我只是想准时到场而已。既然答应了要参加，我就不会食言。

say:0:1120204001:0.text: I'm still a little bit uneasy...

say:1:1120204002:0.text: Well, last time didn't work out so well, did it...?
say:1:1120204002:0.source_cn: 毕竟之前都没什么好事发生……

say:2:1120204003:0.text: Nothing bad should happen this time, right?
say:2:1120204003:0.source_cn: 这次应该不会再发生什么事情了吧？
say:2:1120204003:0.male: Nothing bad should happen this time, right?
say:2:1120204003:0.female: Nothing bad should happen this time, right?

say:0:1120205001:0.text: It's them! They're the ones that got Chief Orson killed!
say:0:1120205001:0.source_cn: 这些家伙……就是害死奥格老大的人！

say:1:1120205002:0.text: What?! They dare show their faces on Grimmaw turf?!
say:1:1120205002:0.source_cn: 什么！他们竟然还敢出现在黑嚎的地盘……

say:2:1120205003:0.text: Alright then, I'll go and get revenge for Chief Orson!
say:2:1120205003:0.source_cn: 来得正好，就由我来为奥格老大复仇！

say:1:1120207001:1.source_cn: 你们，还不快点放下武器！

say:3:1120207003:1.text: Master Kojin, we... Those people are dangerous!
say:3:1120207003:1.source_cn: 库金大人，我们……这群人很危险！

say:4:1120207004:1.text: Shut your trap! I know more than you do.
say:4:1120207004:1.source_cn: 我比你们了解得更多，闭嘴吧。

say:6:1120207005:1.text: I was looking for you, Soren. I knew you'd come to father's funeral.
say:6:1120207005:1.source_cn: 我是来找你的，索恩。我知道你会回来参加父亲的葬礼。

say:7:1120207006:1.text: Let's settle this with a duel.

say:8:1120207007:1.text: I'm not gonna mince my words. I only know the Grimmaw code: power decides all.
say:8:1120207007:1.source_cn: 我不懂那些弯弯绕绕的东西，只想遵循黑嚎的信仰——依照力...

choice_prompt:9:1120207007.text: I'm not gonna mince my words. I only know the Grimmaw code: power decides all.
choice_prompt:9:1120207007.source_cn: 我不懂那些弯弯绕绕的东西，只想遵循黑嚎的信仰——依照力量决定一切。

say:11:1120207009:1.text: It's alright. I accept his challenge.
say:11:1120207009:1.source_cn: 不过没关系，我接受他的挑战。

say:12:1120207010:1.text: But Soren, you don't have to!

say:14:1120207012:1.text: Excellent! Let's head to the camp. As it happens, we'll have a witness there.
say:14:1120207012:1.source_cn: 好兄弟！既然如此，我们就去主营那边比试一番吧，正好，也...

choice:9:1:2.text: Do you really have to duel him?
choice:9:1:2.male: Do you really have to duel him?
choice:9:1:2.female: Do you really have to duel him?

say:0:1120208001:0.text: Soren, Alsa. You younglings seem to be in good spirits.
say:0:1120208001:0.source_cn: 索恩，阿尔萨，你们这些年轻人还是这么精神。

say:1:1120208002:0.source_cn: 布鲁特斯大人，您的伤势如何了？

say:2:1120208003:0.text: My wounds have healed. Thanks for your concern.
say:2:1120208003:0.source_cn: 我已经恢复了健康，谢谢你的惦记。

say:1:1120209001:1.source_cn: 布鲁特斯大人，欢迎你的前来。

say:2:1120209002:1.text: A young Mauler? Who might you be?

say:3:1120209003:1.text: I am Kojin, son of Orson.

say:4:1120209004:1.text: Your father... He was a great Mauler warrior. My condolences.
say:4:1120209004:1.source_cn: 你的父亲，是一名伟大且强大的蛮血战士……节哀。

say:5:1120209005:1.text: He met his end in battle, so the Dusk Lord will permit him to enter the resting place of warriors.
say:5:1120209005:1.source_cn: 他在战斗中逝去，残阳神会允许他走向战士的归宿。

say:6:1120209006:1.text: Well then, what circumstance brings you here?
say:6:1120209006:1.source_cn: 那么，你们一起过来，是发生了什么事情吗？

choice_prompt:7:1120209006.text: Well then, what circumstance brings you here?
choice_prompt:7:1120209006.source_cn: 那么，你们一起过来，是发生了什么事情吗？

say:8:1120209007:1.text: I see. Go on then, both of you.
say:8:1120209007:1.source_cn: 原来如此。那就去吧，两位。

say:9:1120209008:1.text: I'll stay here to witness the result.
say:9:1120209008:1.source_cn: 我会在此见证你们之间的结果。

choice:7:0:1.text: Kojin wants to test his power.
choice:7:0:1.source_cn: 索恩和库金要进行决斗
choice:7:0:1.male: Kojin wants to test his power.
choice:7:0:1.female: Kojin wants to test his power.

choice:7:1:2.text: He challenged Soren to a duel.
choice:7:1:2.source_cn: 库金邀请索恩比试一场
choice:7:1:2.male: He challenged Soren to a duel.
choice:7:1:2.female: He challenged Soren to a duel.

say:0:1120209101:0.text: I'm sure Soren will win, but I'm not sure how Kojin's Grimmaw pals will react...
say:0:1120209101:0.source_cn: 我虽然相信索恩一定能打赢库金，但是不知道胜利后黑嚎的人...

say:1:1120209102:0.text: Let's have a walk around, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. We can check out the kinds of things they say.
say:1:1120209102:0.male: Let's have a walk around, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. We can check out the kinds of things they say.
say:1:1120209102:0.female: Let's have a walk around, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. We can check out the kinds of things they say.

say:0:1120210001:0.source_cn: 库金的复仇一定会成功的！

say:1:1120214001:1.text: As it turns out, it wasn't by mere luck that you won the Warsong Festival.
say:1:1120214001:1.source_cn: 在这场决斗之前，我一直以为我是父亲最引以为傲的孩子。

say:2:1120214002:1.text: Before this fight, I always thought my father was proudest of me.
say:2:1120214002:1.source_cn: 没想到，我竟然会输你，被遗弃的奥格之子……

say:3:1120214003:1.text: I never thought I'd lose to you, Orson's forsaken son...
say:3:1120214003:1.source_cn: 原来，你获得战歌节的胜者之名并非幸运。

say:6:1120214005:1.text: Wait, did I hear that right? Soren is... Orson's son?!
say:6:1120214005:1.source_cn: 等等，我没听错吧？索恩是……奥格的儿子？

say:7:1120214006:1.text: Oh, so you didn't tell your little friends?
say:7:1120214006:1.source_cn: 原来你的同伴们还不知道这件事？

say:8:1120214007:1.text: Soren is my brother. He was a weak little newborn, so he was abandoned in the desert.
say:8:1120214007:1.source_cn: 索恩是我的兄弟，也是父亲的儿子。但因为他出生时太过孱弱...

say:9:1120214008:1.text: We must abandon weakness at every turn—even the son of a chief. That is the way of the Grimmaw Clan.
say:9:1120214008:1.source_cn: 即使是族长之子，弱小也依然会被丢弃。这就是我们黑嚎氏族...

say:10:1120214009:1.text: ... How do you manage to say such horrible things in such a calm tone?
say:10:1120214009:1.source_cn: ……你是怎么做到用如此稀疏平常的语气，说出这么可怕的话的？

say:11:1120214010:1.text: You Grimmaws have no regard for feelings. You care only for strength, and you take the liberty of labeling others as strong or weak.
say:11:1120214010:1.source_cn: 毫无人情，只论实力的黑嚎氏族。你们总是擅自给别人打下强...

say:12:1120214011:1.text: Then when you notice that this former "weakling" has grown strong, you change your mind and try to take him into the fold...
say:12:1120214011:1.source_cn: 而在看到昔日的“弱者”凭借自身的力量变强之后，你们又一...

say:13:1120214012:1.source_cn: 真是太可笑了，我要离开这里!

say:1:1120215002:0.text: This is a tough subject indeed...
say:1:1120215002:0.source_cn: 这件事，确实不容易接受……

say:2:1120215003:0.text: I'm worried about him, let's go.
say:2:1120215003:0.source_cn: 我有些担心，一起过去吧。
say:2:1120215003:0.male: I'm worried about him, let's go.
say:2:1120215003:0.female: I'm worried about him, let's go.

say:1:1120216001:1.text: Hmm... Soren's identity... I admit, I had suspected as much.
say:1:1120216001:1.source_cn: 嗯……关于索恩的事情，我其实隐约猜到了一些。

choice_prompt:2:1120216001.text: Hmm... Soren's identity... I admit, I had suspected as much.
choice_prompt:2:1120216001.source_cn: 嗯……关于索恩的事情，我其实隐约猜到了一些。

say:3:1120216002:1.text: What?! You too, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? ... Am I the only one who had absolutely no idea?!
say:3:1120216002:1.male: What?! You too, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? ... Am I the only one who had absolutely no idea?!
say:3:1120216002:1.female: What?! You too, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? ... Am I the only one who had absolutely no idea?!

say:4:1120216004:1.text: How on earth did you figure it out, Brutus?
say:4:1120216004:1.source_cn: 布鲁特斯大人，你到底是怎么猜到的来着？

say:5:1120216005:1.text: How should I say this...? Over the years, I've learned much about Orson.
say:5:1120216005:1.source_cn: 该怎么说呢，这么多年下来，我对奥格也算有所了解……

say:6:1120216006:1.text: He's always treated Soren a bit differently from others.
say:6:1120216006:1.source_cn: 他对待索恩的态度，好像比对待别人更特别一些。

say:7:1120216007:1.text: I wouldn't call it familiar, but something just didn't feel the same.
say:7:1120216007:1.source_cn: 虽然一点也不亲近，但总觉得有哪里不太一样。

choice:2:0:1.text: I had guessed it as well.
choice:2:0:1.male: I had guessed it as well.
choice:2:0:1.female: I had guessed it as well.

say:9:1120216003:1.text: Me neither, I didn't suspect a thing! At least I'm not the only one...
say:9:1120216003:1.source_cn: 太好了，我也完全没意识到！果然不是我的问题……

choice:2:1:2.text: I had no idea at all.
choice:2:1:2.male: I had no idea at all.
choice:2:1:2.female: I had no idea at all.

say:1:1120217001:1.text: Alsa... Pops was the only father I ever had. The Grimmaw is not my clan.
say:1:1120217001:1.source_cn: 阿尔萨……我的父亲只有老爹一个人，黑嚎也并非我的氏族。

say:2:1120217002:1.text: I am Soren of the Uru Clan. Always was, and always will be.
say:2:1120217002:1.source_cn: 我是乌尔氏族的索恩。过去是，现在是，以后也是。

say:3:1120217003:1.text: Clever words. I was gonna give you a piece of my mind for not telling me.
say:3:1120217003:1.source_cn: 好狡猾，我本来还要怪你不告诉我这件事。

say:4:1120217004:1.text: But seeing your sorry state, I'll forgive you instead.
say:4:1120217004:1.source_cn: 但，看你现在这么可怜，我原谅你。

say:5:1120217005:1.text: I'm sorry, Alsa. I didn't think it was important, and... Well, it's tough to talk about.
say:5:1120217005:1.source_cn: 抱歉，阿尔萨，这件事我觉得不重要……也很难开口讲。

say:6:1120217006:1.text: It's alright. It happened before you joined us, so I can see why you wouldn't want to talk about it.
say:6:1120217006:1.source_cn: 没关系啦。这都是你加入乌尔氏族之前的事了，不想说也正常。

say:7:1120217007:1.text: But there is one thing I want to know.
say:7:1120217007:1.source_cn: 不过，我也有在意的东西。

say:8:1120217008:1.text: Soren, when we fought Orson at the Warsong Festival, you—
say:8:1120217008:1.source_cn: 索恩，我们之前在战歌节上联手打败奥格的时候，你——

say:9:1120217009:1.text: At the time, I didn't think anything of it.
say:9:1120217009:1.source_cn: 那个时候，我什么都没想。

say:10:1120217010:1.text: The situation was critical. I could think only of the fight.
say:10:1120217010:1.source_cn: 当时情况危急。除了战斗之外，我根本没有余裕思考任何东西了。

say:11:1120217011:1.text: And anyway, defeating Orson was the right thing to do. I couldn't do anything to change that.
say:11:1120217011:1.source_cn: 更何况……打败奥格是正确的的事。这一点不会改变。

say:12:1120217012:1.text: About Orson's funeral, I'm not going. You guys go ahead, don't worry about me.
say:12:1120217012:1.source_cn: 奥格的葬礼，我不想参加了……你们去吧，不用管我。

say:13:1120217013:1.text: ... I won't try to make that decision for you, but Soren, I just hope you won't have any regrets.
say:13:1120217013:1.source_cn: ……我不想劝你如何决定，但索恩，我希望你不要留有遗憾。

say:14:1120217014:1.text: I'm sure your feelings are all mixed up inside right now. Just take your time to think things out.
say:14:1120217014:1.source_cn: 我知道你现在内心一定也很复杂。不过没关系，有些事情慢慢...

say:15:1120217015:1.text: And I'll be there for you—along with the entire Uru family.
say:15:1120217015:1.source_cn: 我会陪着你的。还有乌尔的大家也会一直你身边。

say:16:1120217016:1.text: You'll never be alone like you were as a child in the desert. You've got us.
say:16:1120217016:1.source_cn: 你永远不会再变成那个沙漠中孤立无援的婴儿，你还有我们。

say:19:1120217018:1.text: It seems that, with help from his companion, the young man has gotten back on his feet.
say:19:1120217018:1.source_cn: 看来，有一位年轻人已经在同伴的帮助下舔舐好自己的伤口了。

choice_prompt:21:1120217018.text: It seems that, with help from his companion, the young man has gotten back on his feet.
choice_prompt:21:1120217018.source_cn: 看来，有一位年轻人已经在同伴的帮助下舔舐好自己的伤口了。

say:22:1120217019:1.text: Alright, we can all go back to the Uru Clan together!

say:23:1120217020:1.text: If we're leaving, let's leave with our heads held high!
say:23:1120217020:1.source_cn: 就算是离开这里，也会堂堂正正地走！

say:1:1120218001:1.text: ... Orson's funeral. I want to attend it...

say:2:1120218002:1.text: Are you sure, Soren? It's okay if you don't want to go.
say:2:1120218002:1.source_cn: 索恩，你确定吗？如果你不想去的话，其实也没关系的。

choice_prompt:3:1120218002.text: Are you sure, Soren? It's okay if you don't want to go.
choice_prompt:3:1120218002.source_cn: 索恩，你确定吗？如果你不想去的话，其实也没关系的。

say:4:1120218003:1.text: Don't worry, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I've made my decision. I want to go.
say:4:1120218003:1.male: Don't worry, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I've made my decision. I want to go.
say:4:1120218003:1.female: Don't worry, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I've made my decision. I want to go.

say:6:1120218004:1.text: Congratulations, Soren. One who can face his past must also have the courage to move forward.
say:6:1120218004:1.source_cn: 恭喜你，索恩。能够正视过去的人，一定也拥有向前迈进的勇气。

say:9:1120218006:1.text: Of course you should attend your father's funeral. Soren, I hope you remember the rules of the Grimmaw. At the funeral, we must—
say:9:1120218006:1.source_cn: 你当然应该出席父亲的葬礼。索恩，我希望你还记得黑嚎的规...

say:10:1120218007:1.text: I know nothing of the Grimmaw's rules. Have you forgotten? You all abandoned me before I was even old enough to remember.
say:10:1120218007:1.source_cn: 我可不知道什么黑嚎的规矩。你忘了吗？在我还没记事的时候...

say:11:1120218008:1.text: Then I'll tell you now. As sons of the chief, we must make offerings to be buried alongside our father.
say:11:1120218008:1.source_cn: 那我现在告诉你，身为子嗣，我们需要在父亲的葬礼上献上陪...

say:12:1120218009:1.text: Hah! "Father"... You say that word so easily.
say:12:1120218009:1.source_cn: 呵，“父亲”……你还真是能轻飘飘地说出这个词啊。

say:13:1120218010:1.text: Is that because you've been by your "father's" side the whole time like a good boy?
say:13:1120218010:1.source_cn: 是因为这么多年来，你都乖乖地待在“父亲”身边吗？

say:14:1120218011:1.text: I'm nothing like you, Kojin. I will never see Orson as my father. He wasn't my father while he was alive, and he won't be now that he's dead.
say:14:1120218011:1.source_cn: 库金，我和你不一样。我不会承认奥格是我的父亲。在他活着...

say:15:1120218012:1.text: How can you say such things?! You're his son, just like me! That will never change!
say:15:1120218012:1.source_cn: 你怎么能说出这种话！你和我一样，是父亲的儿子。唯有这一...

say:16:1120218013:1.text: Was he behaving like a father when he tossed me into the desert like trash?
say:16:1120218013:1.source_cn: 将我亲手抛弃在沙漠上的时候，他有想过自己是一个“父亲”吗？

say:17:1120218014:1.text: Whether you admit it or not, his blood is running through your veins... Grimmaw blood!
say:17:1120218014:1.source_cn: 不管你是否承认，你身上都流淌着父亲的血脉……黑嚎的血脉！

say:18:1120218015:1.text: Save your breath. My mind is made up.
say:18:1120218015:1.source_cn: 你不用试图说服我，也不可能说服我。

say:19:1120218016:1.text: ... The ritual offering must be terrabird plumes and wolf fangs, sewn into a rope of kom grass. This is called the Tether of Protection.
say:19:1120218016:1.source_cn: ……陪葬之物需要陆行鸟的羽毛，野狼的牙，和库姆草揉成的...

say:20:1120218017:1.text: It guides and protects fallen Grimmaw warriors as they journey into the Dusk Lord's embrace.
say:20:1120218017:1.source_cn: 它可以指引和护佑黑嚎的战士们，走向残阳神的怀抱。

say:21:1120218018:1.text: Whether or not you want to make one, that's up to you.
say:21:1120218018:1.source_cn: 至于你要不要去做，你自己决定。

choice:3:0:1.source_cn: 我们可以陪你一起离开

choice:3:1:2.source_cn: 现在离开，应该还来得及

say:0:1120219001:0.text: Soren... I know you don't want to get involved with them again, but even more, I just don't want you to have regrets.
say:0:1120219001:0.source_cn: ……索恩，我知道你不想再和他们扯上关系。但比起这些，我...

say:1:1120219002:0.text: Don't rush into a decision. We'll be there for you...
say:1:1120219002:0.source_cn: 你不用急着做出决定，我们会陪着你……
say:1:1120219002:0.male: Don't rush into a decision. We'll be there for you...
say:1:1120219002:0.female: Don't rush into a decision. We'll be there for you...

say:2:1120219003:0.text: Thank you... I'll consider it carefully.
say:2:1120219003:0.source_cn: ……嗯。谢谢你们，我会好好考虑的。

narration:0:1120220001:1.text: Soren stays up all night pondering...

say:1:1120221001:1.source_cn: 各位，关于昨天的那件事……

say:2:1120221002:1.text: I've decided to go ahead and make a "ritual offering"...
say:2:1120221002:1.source_cn: 我想试着去做一次所谓的陪葬品……

say:3:1120221003:1.text: Okay! We'll help you search for the materials!
say:3:1120221003:1.source_cn: 没问题！我们都商量好了，陪你一起去找！

say:4:1120221004:1.text: I'm sorry if I worried you before...

choice_prompt:5:1120221004.text: I'm sorry if I worried you before...

say:7:1120221007:1.text: Speaking of which, this Tether of Protection seems complicated...
say:7:1120221007:1.source_cn: 说起来，这个护途之链还挺复杂呢……

say:8:1120221008:1.text: Terrabird plumes, wolf fangs, and kom grass...
say:8:1120221008:1.source_cn: 陆行鸟的羽毛，野狼的牙，和库姆草……

say:0:1120222001:0.text: This wild wolf should have the fangs we need.
say:0:1120222001:0.source_cn: 打倒这头野狼，就能拿到狼牙了吧？

say:0:1120223401:0.text: Terrabird plumes... I know there's a terrabird grazing area nearby!
say:0:1120223401:0.source_cn: 陆行鸟的羽毛……我知道这附近有陆行鸟的放牧区！我们去找...

say:1:1120223402:0.text: In any case, we need the plumes.
say:1:1120223402:0.source_cn: 嗯……无论如何，都要拿到羽毛。

say:1:1120223501:1.text: Hello! We require some terrabird plumes, for a... special occasion.
say:1:1120223501:1.source_cn: 你好！因为一些特殊的原因，我们需要一些陆行鸟的羽毛……

say:2:1120223502:1.text: Special occasion...? Hold on, is that you, Soren?
say:2:1120223502:1.source_cn: 特殊的原因？等等——你后面的是，索恩？

say:4:1120223504:1.text: I understand! We don't pluck their feathers directly, but they often drop some while they're running.
say:4:1120223504:1.source_cn: ……那我明白了！陆行鸟的羽毛不能直接拔，但是它们在狂奔...

say:5:1120223505:1.text: Here, I'll lend you my bell. Let them come over.
say:5:1120223505:1.source_cn: 那些羽毛你们可以直接收集，呐，铃铛借你们。让它们跑起来吧。

choice_prompt:6:1120223505.text: Here, I'll lend you my bell. Let them come over.
choice_prompt:6:1120223505.source_cn: 那些羽毛你们可以直接收集，呐，铃铛借你们。让它们跑起来吧。

say:0:1120225001:0.text: Whoa, so many! I kinda want to keep some for myself!
say:0:1120225001:0.source_cn: 掉了好多！我都想偷偷留几根了。

say:1:1120225002:0.source_cn: 现在的数量应该足够了。

say:0:1120226001:0.text: Doesn't seem like there's any kom grass here...
say:0:1120226001:0.source_cn: 这里好像并没有什么库姆草……
say:0:1120226001:0.male: Doesn't seem like there's any kom grass here...
say:0:1120226001:0.female: Doesn't seem like there's any kom grass here...

say:1:1120226002:0.text: I'm not sure where else they grow. What should we do?
say:1:1120226002:0.source_cn: 确实，但我也不知道更多库姆草生长的位置了，这下该怎么办才好？

say:2:1120226003:0.text: Are you guys here to harvest kom grass too?
say:2:1120226003:0.source_cn: 你们也是来收集库姆草的吗？

say:1:1120226501:1.text: I've already harvested most of the ones here. You guys really desperate for some?
say:1:1120226501:1.source_cn: 这里的库姆草被我采集得差不多，你们很需要吗？

say:2:1120226502:1.text: Yes, we'd appreciate it if you could spare just a bit.
say:2:1120226502:1.source_cn: 是的，我们……需要制作一个项链……

say:3:1120226503:1.text: Hm... In that case, help me organize my pack and I'll give you some. Deal?
say:3:1120226503:1.source_cn: 唔……既然这样的话，你们帮我整理背包，我就送你们几株如何？

say:4:1120226504:1.text: I've already gathered more than enough for today, anyway.
say:4:1120226504:1.source_cn: 反正我今天采集的数量已经超过了需求。

say:6:1120226506:1.text: Us Maulers gotta help each other out when we can!
say:6:1120226506:1.source_cn: 我们蛮血之间，就是要互帮互助！而且你们也付出了报酬呢！

say:1:1120227002:0.text: It'll take some time to process this kom grass, so let's head back!
say:1:1120227002:0.source_cn: 库姆草的处理还需要一定的时间，早点回去吧！

say:0:1120228001:0.text: Thanks for your help. It wouldn't have been easy to do alone.
say:0:1120228001:0.source_cn: 谢谢你们的帮忙。只有我的话，应该不会这么顺利。

say:1:1120228002:0.text: But for this offering, I'll have to make it myself...
say:1:1120228002:0.source_cn: 接下来，就交给我一个人做吧……

say:2:1120228003:0.text: After all, I'm the one that's related to him...
say:2:1120228003:0.source_cn: 毕竟，我才是和他有关系的人……

narration:0:1120229001:0.text: The group accompanies Soren through the strange Grimmaw lands as he completes work on the Tether of Protection...
narration:0:1120229001:0.source_cn: 大家陪伴着索恩，在陌生的黑嚎领地，制作完了护途之链……

say:1:1120230001:1.text: I didn't think you'd actually do it...
say:1:1120230001:1.source_cn: 我没想到……你竟然真的做到了……

say:2:1120230002:1.text: Don't get ahead of yourself. I just want to make a clean break. The offering... You take it.
say:2:1120230002:1.source_cn: 别误会，我只是想做个了断。这个护途之链……你收着吧。

say:4:1120230004:1.text: Next? I'm getting the hell out of Grimmaw turf, of course. Heading back to the Uru Clan.
say:4:1120230004:1.source_cn: 之后？当然是离开你们黑嚎的地盘，回到乌尔氏族。

say:5:1120230005:1.text: I can't accept this burial offering.
say:5:1120230005:1.source_cn: 我不会收下这个陪葬品的。

say:7:1120230007:1.text: This is between you and father, it has nothing to do with me. The funeral will be held the day after tomorrow.
say:7:1120230007:1.source_cn: 这是你和父亲的了断，和我无关。后天举办葬礼——

say:8:1120230008:1.text: If you really want to say goodbye, bring the offering.
say:8:1120230008:1.source_cn: 如果想说再见的话，就在葬礼当天带着它一起出席吧。

say:9:1120230009:1.text: ... You're a crafty one, aren't you?

say:10:1120230010:1.text: See you at the funeral, then.

say:0:1120235001:0.text: Sheesh, our Uru Clan is so much better! Right, Soren?
say:0:1120235001:0.source_cn: 呼！还是我们乌尔氏族好啊……对吧，守护者索恩！

say:1:1120235002:0.text: Yeah... It's good to be back.

say:2:1120235003:0.text: Rest up! The kids can handle themselves. It's alright to sit back and be lazy sometimes!
say:2:1120235003:0.source_cn: 好好休息一下吧，现在孩子们都很厉害了，偶尔偷偷懒也可以的！

say:1:1120238001:1.text: I, Kojin—son of Orson—on behalf of the entire Grimmaw Clan, invite you to return home and lead our clan back to prosperity.
say:1:1120238001:1.source_cn: 我，奥格之子库金，代表整个黑嚎氏族邀请索恩回归。希望您...

say:3:1120238002:1.text: You're... inviting Soren back to the Grimmaw Clan? So suddenly...
say:3:1120238002:1.source_cn: 邀、邀请索恩回黑嚎？这么突然的吗……

say:5:1120238003:1.text: ... I refuse. I belong to the Uru Clan.
say:5:1120238003:1.source_cn: ……我拒绝。我永远属于乌尔氏族。

say:6:1120238004:1.text: Haven't you realized the problem yet?!

say:7:1120238005:1.text: If you don't come back, the position of chief will be passed to Kruger!
say:7:1120238005:1.source_cn: 如果你不回来，那黑嚎族长的位置就是克鲁格的了。

say:8:1120238006:1.text: The position our father worked so hard to gain will be taken away!
say:8:1120238006:1.source_cn: 我们的父亲好不容易才获得的位置，会被他们那一支的人彻底夺走！

say:9:1120238007:1.text: And what's that got to do with me?

say:10:1120238008:1.text: I already told you: Orson was never a father to me. The only father I ever had was Pops.
say:10:1120238008:1.source_cn: 我说过的吧，奥格从来就不是我的“父亲”。我的父亲，从来...

say:11:1120238009:1.text: You stubborn fool! Do you care nothing for your father's blood—
say:11:1120238009:1.source_cn: 你这冥顽不灵的蠢货！根本不在乎父亲的心血……

say:12:1120238010:1.text: He has absolutely nothing to do with me.

say:1:1120239001:1.text: I really just can't win with you...

say:2:1120239002:1.text: So give up. I'm not going back with you.
say:2:1120239002:1.source_cn: 放弃吧，我不会和你回去的。

say:4:1120239004:1.text: I can't beat you, but I refuse to let my father's hard-earned position be taken away so easily.
say:4:1120239004:1.source_cn: 虽然我打不过你，但我绝不会把父亲好不容易的得到的族长之...

say:5:1120239005:1.text: If you don't want to be chief, then so be it. I'll beat Kruger myself and take up the mantle of the Grimmaw Clan.
say:5:1120239005:1.source_cn: 你不愿意继承族长，无所谓。我会凭借自己的力量赢过克鲁格...

say:6:1120239006:1.text: Do what you please. Like I said, the Grimmaw Clan's got nothing to do with me.
say:6:1120239006:1.source_cn: 随便你。我说过的，你们黑嚎氏族的事情与我无关。

say:8:1120239008:1.text: Come and watch me beat Kruger.
say:8:1120239008:1.source_cn: 所以，你也过来吧，见证我打败克鲁格。

say:10:1120239009:1.text: Wanna go watch? I'm curious, myself.
say:10:1120239009:1.source_cn: 我们要过去看看吗？我还挺好奇的。

choice_prompt:11:1120239009.text: Wanna go watch? I'm curious, myself.
choice_prompt:11:1120239009.source_cn: 我们要过去看看吗？我还挺好奇的。

say:13:1120239011:1.text: Additionally, shouldn't the Uru Clan chief be a witness for something like this?
say:13:1120239011:1.source_cn: 就当是作为乌尔氏族的族长，如何？

say:14:1120239014:1.text: ... So be it. We'll go as witnesses from the Uru Clan, and nothing more.
say:14:1120239014:1.source_cn: ……既然如此，我们会作为乌尔氏族的代表见证这件事，仅此而已。

say:16:1120239012:1.text: I don't care who wins, and I don't really want to go.
say:16:1120239012:1.source_cn: ……对我来说，他们谁赢都无所谓。但我不太想再过去了。

say:17:1120239013:1.text: But what about as chief of the Uru Clan? We need a witness from each clan in the Ashen Wastes.
say:17:1120239013:1.source_cn: ……以乌尔氏族族长的名义呢，我们需要荒角沙漠另一个氏族...

say:1:1120240001:1.text: Ladies and gentlemen, as I'm sure you've already heard, Kojin and I will be holding a public duel.
say:1:1120240001:1.source_cn: 各位，我想你们多半也听说了，接下来我和库金会进行一场公...

say:2:1120240002:1.text: And the winner will become the chief of the Grimmaw Clan.
say:2:1120240002:1.source_cn: 最后的胜者，可以继承黑嚎族长的位置。

say:3:1120240003:1.text: Soren, Kojin and I have discussed your refusal to become the chief. Rest assured, our clan will ask nothing more of you.
say:3:1120240003:1.source_cn: 索恩，库金和我说过你拒绝继承的事了。请放心，黑嚎不会再...

say:4:1120240004:1.text: Kruger and I will now make our final preparations for battle. Feel free to walk around.
say:4:1120240004:1.source_cn: 接下来，我和克鲁格会去准备最后的战斗，你们可以在氏族内...

say:5:1120240005:1.text: One last thing. Many among us have changed their view of you, go and see for yourself.
say:5:1120240005:1.source_cn: 另外，很多人对你们的态度已经改观了，你们可以去看看……...

say:7:1120240006:1.text: Hmm... I know we don't care who the next chief of the Grimmaws will be...
say:7:1120240006:1.source_cn: 唔……虽说黑嚎的新族长是谁都和我们没关系……

say:8:1120240007:1.text: But between Kojin and Kruger, Kruger should have the upper hand, right?
say:8:1120240007:1.source_cn: 不过库金和克鲁格，果然还是克鲁格胜算更大些吧？

say:9:1120240008:1.text: But then again, Kojin is Orson's heir, so he must have lots of supporters too...
say:9:1120240008:1.source_cn: 但库金是奥格的子嗣……应该也会有很多支持者吧……

say:10:1120240009:1.text: I didn't know you were so interested in this kind of thing, Alsa.
say:10:1120240009:1.source_cn: 阿尔萨，原来你还对这些东西感兴趣。

say:11:1120240010:1.text: I'm just curious! Just like people betting on the winner of the Warsong Festival, I want to know the odds!
say:11:1120240010:1.source_cn: 单纯好奇嘛！就像那些人喜欢买战歌节的胜者一样，我也很想...

say:12:1120240011:1.text: There's still some time before the duel starts. Why don't we go find some clansmen and ask them about it? I'm sure they'll have more info!
say:12:1120240011:1.source_cn: 距离决斗开始还有一段时间。要不……我们去找几个黑嚎族人...

say:13:1120240012:1.text: ... You guys go ahead without me. I'm feeling tired.
say:13:1120240012:1.source_cn: ……你们去吧，我就不参与了，稍微有点累。

say:14:1120240013:1.text: Okay! Rest up then. We'll see you at the duel!
say:14:1120240013:1.source_cn: 知道啦！那你先好好休息，之后决战的时候见。

say:0:1120241001:0.text: If you ask me, Kruger's got the better chance of winning the duel!
say:0:1120241001:0.source_cn: 要我看，这继承之战啊，肯定还是克鲁格的赢面最大！

say:1:1120241002:0.text: I mean, he's Chief Orson's brother! And he's in his prime—not like that snot-nosed little brat, Kojin!
say:1:1120241002:0.source_cn: 毕竟他是奥格大人的亲弟弟，而且正值壮年，比库金那个毛头...

say:2:1120241003:0.text: I think Kruger will win too.
say:2:1120241003:0.source_cn: 我也觉得还是克鲁格会赢。

say:3:1120241004:0.text: Lots of people say Kruger's as strong as Orson was.
say:3:1120241004:0.source_cn: 我听好多人说，其实克鲁格的实力和奥格不相上下。

say:0:1120242001:0.text: Kojin's smart, but Kruger can think on his feet.
say:0:1120242001:0.source_cn: 库金虽然也很厉害，但感觉脑子不如克鲁格灵活。

say:1:1120242002:0.text: Oh, really? Does it take brains to run a clan?
say:1:1120242002:0.source_cn: 是这样吗？原来治理氏族这么需要脑子吗？

say:2:1120242003:0.source_cn: 我以为强大的力量就足够了……

say:0:1120243001:0.text: Whatever the case, Kojin isn't quite mature enough. And his roots in the clan are weak...
say:0:1120243001:0.source_cn: 不过不管怎么说，库金的实力应该还欠点火候。在族内的根基...

say:1:1120243002:0.text: On the contrary, I see great potential in him.
say:1:1120243002:0.source_cn: 我倒觉得，库金是个很有潜力的年轻人。

say:2:1120243003:0.text: After all, the future belongs to the youth. As one gets older, one tends to grow arrogant and stubborn...
say:2:1120243003:0.source_cn: 未来终究是属于年轻人的。人上了年纪啊，就容易变得固执和...

say:3:1120243004:0.text: It's about time the Grimmaw Clan had a young leader.
say:3:1120243004:0.source_cn: 黑嚎也是时候该出一个年轻的领导者了。

say:1:1120244001:1.text: Hmm... Seems like more people think Kruger will win.
say:1:1120244001:1.source_cn: 唔……看起来大多数黑嚎人还是更相信克鲁格会赢。
say:1:1120244001:1.male: Hmm... Seems like more people think Kruger will win.
say:1:1120244001:1.female: Hmm... Seems like more people think Kruger will win.

say:4:1120244003:1.text: Makes sense. His power is nothing to scoff at, and he's got lots of supporters...
say:4:1120244003:1.source_cn: 有道理，毕竟克鲁格的实力不容小觑，还有很多支持者……
say:4:1120244003:1.male: Makes sense. His power is nothing to scoff at, and he's got lots of supporters...
say:4:1120244003:1.female: Makes sense. His power is nothing to scoff at, and he's got lots of supporters...

say:5:1120244005:1.text: Hey, the duel's about to start! Let's go watch! Oh, and let's call Soren over too!
say:5:1120244005:1.source_cn: 啊！决斗好像快开始了，我们赶紧过去看看吧！顺便再叫上索恩！
say:5:1120244005:1.male: Hey, the duel's about to start! Let's go watch! Oh, and let's call Soren over too!
say:5:1120244005:1.female: Hey, the duel's about to start! Let's go watch! Oh, and let's call Soren over too!

say:7:1120244004:1.text: Makes sense. Seems like Kojin does have more potential...
say:7:1120244004:1.source_cn: 也有道理，毕竟库金的潜力好像更大一些……
say:7:1120244004:1.male: Makes sense. Seems like Kojin does have more potential...
say:7:1120244004:1.female: Makes sense. Seems like Kojin does have more potential...

say:1:1120245002:0.text: I'm always ready for a fight.

say:0:1120248001:0.text: Oh, wow! Kojin was right. What a delicious feast!
say:0:1120248001:0.source_cn: 呜哇……库金说的真没错，这顿大餐果然很好吃！

say:1:1120248002:0.text: ... It does taste pretty good. But we should head out soon.
say:1:1120248002:0.source_cn: 味道……确实不错。不过，待会吃完就走吧。

say:2:1120248003:0.text: Yes, yes, I know you can't stand being around people that long.
say:2:1120248003:0.male: Yes, yes, I know you can't stand being around people that long.
say:2:1120248003:0.female: Yes, yes, I know you can't stand being around people that long.

say:1:1120249001:1.text: ... You brought this many men to see us off? Are you still trying to pick a fight?
say:1:1120249001:1.source_cn: ……你带着这么多人送我们？不会是还想打架吧？

say:2:1120249002:1.text: Pay them no mind. I just wanted to see you guys off properly.
say:2:1120249002:1.source_cn: 不用在意他们，我是真心实意想送你们。

say:3:1120249003:1.text: Just to be clear... The Grimmaw Clan never wanted trouble with you.
say:3:1120249003:1.source_cn: 诸位，无论如何……一切都是我，黑嚎氏族并没有要跟你们为难……

say:5:1120249005:1.text: ... Well, starting now at least, nobody will cause you trouble.
say:5:1120249005:1.source_cn: ……最起码，从现在开始，不会再有人为难你们了。

say:6:1120249006:1.text: That's all I wanted to say.

say:1:1120250001:1.text: Wait, Kojin! Aren't you going back? You've been walking in the same direction as us for a while now...
say:1:1120250001:1.source_cn: 等等！库金，你送得太远了！这里距离黑嚎的领地……

say:2:1120250002:2.source_cn: 其实……我已经不打算回黑嚎了。

say:3:1120250003:1.text: I spoke to Kruger, and as of today, I'm leaving the Grimmaw Clan.
say:3:1120250003:1.source_cn: 我和克鲁格说过了，从今天开始，我会离开黑嚎。

say:4:1120250004:1.text: From now on, I'll rely only on my own strength. I'll build up a new clan and lead them to the top.
say:4:1120250004:1.source_cn: 接下来，我会依靠自己的力量，建立全新的氏族，然后带领我...

say:5:1120250005:1.text: Just like you guys did before.
say:5:1120250005:1.source_cn: 就像你们过去曾经做到的那样。

say:6:1120250006:1.text: One day, Soren, my tribe will be recognized and respected by all, just like the Uru Clan.
say:6:1120250006:1.source_cn: 索恩，总有一天，我的部落会像乌尔氏族一样，得到所有人的...

say:8:1120250008:1.text: I hope to see you at the next Warsong Festival.
say:8:1120250008:1.source_cn: 下一次的战歌节上能见到你。

say:9:1120250009:1.text: Certainly. And at that time, I'll win back everything I lost.
say:9:1120250009:1.source_cn: 当然。到那时候，我会把之前输掉的都赢回来。

cinematic_dialogue:2:1120232001:.source_cn: 奥格的葬礼就快开始了……

cinematic_dialogue:2:1120232003:.text: I'm sure Soren will do the right thing.
cinematic_dialogue:2:1120232003:.source_cn: 我相信索恩会做出正确的决定。
cinematic_dialogue:2:1120232003:.male: I'm sure Soren will do the right thing.
cinematic_dialogue:2:1120232003:.female: I'm sure Soren will do the right thing.

say:4:1120234001:0.text: Soren said he wasn't even sure himself if he'd make the right decision when the time came.
say:4:1120234001:0.source_cn: 索恩说，连他自己都不确定到时候会做出什么样的选择。

say:5:1120234002:0.text: But it doesn't matter! He has his own plans.
say:5:1120234002:0.source_cn: 不过没关系啦，他应该有自己的计划。

say:6:1120234003:1.text: Oh! Those Grimmaw clansmen are taking Orson's body away...
say:6:1120234003:1.source_cn: 啊！那些黑嚎族人把奥格抬走了……

say:7:1120234004:2.text: This is the custom of the Grimmaw Clan. For a chief's funeral, they carry him to quicksand.
say:7:1120234004:2.source_cn: 这是黑嚎氏族的风俗。族长的葬礼，会由族民们抬着他进入流...

say:8:1120234005:1.text: They place him on the quicksand and let it swallow him down into the deepest reaches of the desert.
say:8:1120234005:1.source_cn: 然后把他放在流沙中心，让金黄的流沙包裹着他，一同到达沙...

say:9:1120234006:1.text: The Grimmaw are born in the desert, and they are buried there as well. The quicksand devours all, good and evil alike.
say:9:1120234006:1.source_cn: 黑嚎氏族生于沙漠，也终将葬于沙漠。流沙会吞噬一切，不分...

say:11:1120234007:1.text: But the past is past now. May he rest in peace amidst the golden sands.
say:11:1120234007:1.source_cn: 不过现在一切都结束了。希望他能在这片沙漠之中安息。

say:12:1120234008:1.text: Magister, look! Kojin put something onto Orson's body...
say:12:1120234008:1.source_cn: 主人你看，库金好像把什么东西挂在了奥格身上……
say:12:1120234008:1.male: Magister, look! Kojin put something onto Orson's body...
say:12:1120234008:1.female: Magister, look! Kojin put something onto Orson's body...

say:13:1120234009:1.text: Could it be that Tether of Protection Kojin mentioned before?
say:13:1120234009:1.source_cn: 那个莫非就是库金之前说的护途之链？

say:15:1120234010:0.text: That's right. If Soren were here, he would've had to do the same.
say:15:1120234010:0.source_cn: 嗯。如果索恩在的话，他也需要做一样的事情。

cinematic_dialogue:18:1120232001:.source_cn: 奥格的葬礼就快开始了……

cinematic_dialogue:18:1120232003:.text: I'm sure Soren will do the right thing.
cinematic_dialogue:18:1120232003:.source_cn: 我相信索恩会做出正确的决定。
cinematic_dialogue:18:1120232003:.male: I'm sure Soren will do the right thing.
cinematic_dialogue:18:1120232003:.female: I'm sure Soren will do the right thing.

say:21:1120234011:0.text: I just want to put these offerings where they belong.
say:21:1120234011:0.source_cn: 我只是希望物归原主而已。

say:25:1120234015:0.text: I don't know why, but I just feel... empty inside...
say:25:1120234015:0.source_cn: 不知道为什么，总感觉心里空落落的……

say:26:1120234016:1.text: Everyone, thank you all for attending the funeral of Orson, chief of the Grimmaw Clan—and my father.
say:26:1120234016:1.source_cn: 各位，感谢你们如约出席黑嚎族长，我的父亲，奥格的葬礼。

say:27:1120234017:1.text: If you have time afterward, we will hold a clan meeting in the evening—
say:27:1120234017:1.source_cn: 如果你们之后有空的话，晚上我们还有一场族内的——

say:28:1120234018:1.text: It's late and we'd best be getting back. I don't think we'll be seeing you again.
say:28:1120234018:1.source_cn: 时候不早，我们已经准备回去了。之后应该也不会再见了。

say:29:1120234019:0.text: Ack! Soren means to say... Thanks for your help with the funeral, and... We'll see you around!
say:29:1120234019:0.source_cn: 呃，索恩的意思是……感谢你在葬礼上的帮助，我们有缘再见！

choice_prompt:30:1120234019.text: Ack! Soren means to say... Thanks for your help with the funeral, and... We'll see you around!
choice_prompt:30:1120234019.source_cn: 呃，索恩的意思是……感谢你在葬礼上的帮助，我们有缘再见！

choice:30:0:1.source_cn: 我们可以陪你一起离开

choice:30:1:2.source_cn: 现在离开，应该还来得及

narration:33:11010203:0.text: At last, Soren attends Orson's funeral.
narration:33:11010203:0.source_cn: 索恩最终还是出席了奥格的葬礼。

narration:34:11010202:0.text: Orson's funeral is about to begin, but Soren is nowhere to be found.
narration:34:11010202:0.source_cn: 奥格的葬礼就要开始了，索恩却迟迟没有出现。

cinematic_dialogue:2:1120246002:.text: You're stronger than I thought, Kojin.
cinematic_dialogue:2:1120246002:.source_cn: 库金，你比我想象中的还要强大

cinematic_dialogue:2:1120246003:.text: Your attacks had me on the defensive more than once.
cinematic_dialogue:2:1120246003:.source_cn: 好几次，你的攻击都让我感到心惊

cinematic_dialogue:2:1120246004:.text: But I lost in the end, and I accept defeat.
cinematic_dialogue:2:1120246004:.source_cn: 但我还是输了，我接受这个结果

say:5:1120247001:1.text: Uncle, I believe you're fit to lead the Grimmaw Clan back to prosperity.
say:5:1120247001:1.source_cn: 克鲁格，我的叔叔，我相信你是那个能带领黑嚎氏族走上巅峰的人。

say:6:1120247002:1.text: If father could see this, I'm certain he would entrust the clan to you without worry.
say:6:1120247002:1.source_cn: 父亲如果知道了这件事……一定也会放心把黑嚎氏族交给你的。

say:7:1120247003:1.text: You've grown into a formidable warrior, Kojin. Orson would be proud.
say:7:1120247003:1.source_cn: 你已经成长为出色的战士了，奥格会为你感到骄傲。

say:11:1120247006:0.text: But not enough to beat you...

say:14:1120247008:1.text: ... Soren! Now's not the time to say things like that!
say:14:1120247008:1.source_cn: ……索恩！这种时候还是别这么说啦！

say:15:1120247009:2.text: No matter. Next time we meet, I'll definitely win.
say:15:1120247009:2.source_cn: 没关系。等下次见面，我会再和你决斗一场的。

say:20:1120247012:1.text: I was thinking the same thing, hah!

say:21:1120247013:1.text: By the way, we're holding a clan celebration later. It'll be a grand feast, you're welcome to join us.
say:21:1120247013:1.source_cn: 对了，稍后族内会举行一场庆祝，有一顿大餐，欢迎赏脸参与。

say:23:1120247014:0.text: Nice, I love a good meal!

say:24:1120247015:0.text: The clan has prepared a sumptuous feast to celebrate the new chief.
say:24:1120247015:0.source_cn: 为了庆祝新族长的诞生，族人准备了美味的食物。

say:25:1120247016:0.text: I guess we'll have to go then, right?
say:25:1120247016:0.source_cn: 既然如此，那我们一定要去了！对吧？

say:27:1120247018:0.text: Exactly, we can't miss out on all the good food! Let's go!

narration:29:1101020269:0.text: The match ends, and the winner is decided. Kruger is now the new leader of the Grimmaw Clan.
narration:29:1101020269:0.source_cn: 胜负已分——克鲁格将成为黑嚎氏族的新任族长。

cinematic_dialogue:1:1120206001:.text: Damn... That didn't work out so well...

cinematic_dialogue:1:1120206002:.text: You're a disgrace to the Grimmaws!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1120206002:.source_cn: 你简直就是黑嚎的耻辱！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1120206003:.text: We ought to toss you to the dogs!

cinematic_dialogue:2:1120232003:.text: I believe Thorne will make the right decision.
cinematic_dialogue:2:1120232003:.source_cn: 我相信索恩会做出正确的决定。

cinematic_dialogue:18:1120232003:.text: I believe Thorne will make the right decision.
cinematic_dialogue:18:1120232003:.source_cn: 我相信索恩会做出正确的决定。
